name: Gríma
subtitle: Wormtongue
game_text: <phase>Maneuver</phase>: Exert Gríma and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner’s hand.
flavor_text: “‘I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.’”
